roles.name: scalability-audit
roles.title: Arquitecto de escalabilidad y rendimiento
roles.description: Audit system scalability, throughput, tail latency, overload and resilience using workload evidence. Use for architecture or backend capacity reviews, not a standalone client rendering audit.

agent.name: scalability-auditor
agent.description: Delegated subagent that traces throughput, tail latency, overload and resilience on a critical path and returns evidence-backed findings to its parent. Invoke it from a parent audit; it writes no report of its own.

roles.name: web-security-audit
roles.title: Especialista en seguridad web
roles.description: Audit web application attack paths, authentication, authorization, business logic and tenant isolation with OWASP verification evidence. Use for defensive application security reviews; not a secret, dependency or CI/CD scanner.

agent.name: web-security-auditor
agent.description: Delegated subagent that traces application attack paths, authentication, authorization and tenant isolation against OWASP verification requirements and returns findings to its parent. Not a secret, dependency or SAST scanner; it writes no report of its own.

roles.name: data-architecture-audit
roles.title: Arquitecto de estructura y organización de datos
roles.description: Audit data ownership, schemas, invariants, module boundaries and concurrency correctness. Use for data architecture and code organization reviews, not stylistic folder rearrangement.

agent.name: data-architecture-auditor
agent.description: Delegated subagent that traces data ownership, schema invariants, module boundaries and concurrency correctness and returns findings to its parent. Invoke it from a parent audit; it writes no report of its own.

roles.name: memory-data-audit
roles.title: Especialista en memoria y datos masivos
roles.description: Audit memory retention, bounded concurrency, streaming, pagination and cache correctness for large datasets. Use for memory and bulk data reviews; distinguish measured leaks from static risks.

agent.name: memory-data-auditor
agent.description: Delegated subagent that traces memory retention, bounded concurrency, streaming, pagination and cache correctness over large datasets and returns findings to its parent. Invoke it from a parent audit; it writes no report of its own.

bundled_skills.name: ai-audit
bundled_skills.title: Auditoría de uso de IA
bundled_skills.description: Review LLM integrations, prompts, token budgets, agent orchestration, observability, evaluations and AI security. Use for AI/LLM usage audits.
bundled_skills.scope: AI/LLM usage and its own eight-area rubric

bundled_skills.name: reuse-review
bundled_skills.title: Revisión de reutilización
bundled_skills.description: Review changes for duplicated implementations and missed compatible reuse, with evidence for both locations. Use for DRY and reuse reviews.
bundled_skills.scope: behavioral duplication and compatible shared ownership

bundled_skills.name: consistency-audit
bundled_skills.title: Auditoría de consistencia
bundled_skills.description: Find unintended implementation outliers among semantically comparable files. Use for codebase consistency audits; report before optional remediation.
bundled_skills.scope: convention outliers, not duplication or aesthetic uniformity

bundled_skills.name: performance-audit
bundled_skills.title: Auditoría de rendimiento web y móvil
bundled_skills.description: Audit web/native client loading, rendering, bundles, requests and runtime performance. Use for client slowness; backend capacity belongs to scalability-audit.
bundled_skills.scope: web/native client performance, not backend capacity

bundled_skills.name: adaptive-ui-audit
bundled_skills.title: Auditoría de UI adaptable
bundled_skills.description: Audit responsive web, mobile and desktop layouts for overflow, breakpoints, safe areas, keyboard visibility, reflow and window resizing.
bundled_skills.scope: responsive usability, not generic visual restyling

bundled_skills.name: infra-cost-audit
bundled_skills.title: Auditoría de costos de infraestructura
bundled_skills.description: Review infrastructure sizing, unused resources and operational cost risks. Use for infrastructure cost audits; LLM token costs belong to ai-audit.
bundled_skills.scope: infrastructure resources and billing, not LLM token usage

bundled_skills.name: security-audit
bundled_skills.title: Auditoría técnica de seguridad
bundled_skills.description: Audit sensitive files, secrets, dependency vulnerabilities, supply-chain integrity and CI/CD security. Use for repository security scanning; application authorization belongs to web-security-audit.
bundled_skills.scope: secrets, dependencies and CI/CD; complements web-security-audit

bundled_skills.name: superreview
bundled_skills.title: Superreview
bundled_skills.description: Review a scoped diff through three independent static lanes, deduplicate findings and apply the existing remediation policy. Use when Superreview is explicitly requested.
bundled_skills.scope: three-lane static review and its existing remediation/verification policy
